Violates C14 (same meaningful default in more than one place) and the skeleton/plan directive 'clap parses a u16 privately (default DEFAULT_PORT.get()), converted once to Port'.

findings.finding: serve_emits_no_second_success_line (main.rs:578-580) is a tautology: assert!(matches!(Control::Served, Control::Served)) exercises no code path, and the named behavior (a second JSON success line must not print after startup; main.rs:104-110) is unpinned anywhere - the cucumber harness parses only the first stdout line and drains the rest (http.rs:101,125-130); browser resolves on the first newline (console.ts:212-232). findings.finding: Every 405 response omits the RFC 9110 15.5.5-mandated Allow header: method_guard (console.rs:422-429) returns 405 Body::empty() with no headers on every route; it is the sole 405 source (runs before routing). Fix is one Allow: GET, HEAD header.
findings.refuting_evidence: none found; no recorded decision excludes the header; guard position does not excuse omission (only GET/HEAD are served, so an accurate Allow is trivially available)

findings.refuting_evidence: The structure is operator-adjudicated: Card seq 70 records the C13 finding 'publication materializes owned JSON/strings despite existing writer sink' (disposition: survives narrowly at publication caller; accessor retained) and mandates the repair 'Stream publication through a PRIVATE serialization path without that owned Value/string preparation. Keep public to_json()/url() API and their standalone behavior unchanged'; seq 71 records acceptance. The finding's proposed remedy (publish through to_json, delete wrappers) reinstates the adjudicated defect. Drift rationale also false: publish_writes_one_line_and_flushes and publish_handles_partial_writes byte-compare wire output against serde_json::to_string(&startup.to_json()) (console.rs:827-842), so divergence fails the suite. Residue (doc comment recording the divergence rationale at the StartupWire definition) noted as documentation nicety, below the bar.

findings.finding: Plan-mandated failure-injection tests assert success paths. Refutation narrowed the original in three places but the core stands: (a) SURVIVES AS STATED - host_rejection_precedes_unreadable_storage (console.rs:611-615) uses the healthy reader() fixture, never makes storage unreadable, so the ordering property its name claims (rejection precedes reads, plan line 86) has no instrument anywhere (cucumber 421 scenarios also run on healthy storage); (b)-(d) NARROWED to named-case conformance defects: stream_failure_has_queue_without_partial_card (console.rs:661-670) exercises the unknown-Card 404 path, queue_failure_has_no_queue_or_card (console.rs:673-676) asserts 200 OK against a valid store, serve_uses_published_listener (main.rs:572-575) asserts only clap parsing - each asserts something other than its named behavior (seq 67 violation), though the underlying failure behaviors are separately pinned by the cucumber corruption scenarios (console.feature:464-490) and the harness derives its port from the published startup URL; (e) SURVIVES - no behavioral red evidence exists anywhere in docs/execution/per-84/ (the only red artifact is a compile error, which seq 66 excludes; run2-task3-continuation-handoff.md confirms tests were written after bodies existed).

publish_failure_is_domain_and_prevents_serve (main.rs:553-562) asserts only the Failure::Domain(PublishStartup) mapping; the 'prevents serve' half of the plan-named case is untested - nothing drives main.rs:168-169 sequencing under a publish failure, and no acceptance-layer instrument can inject a stdout failure, so this unit test is the only possible pin.

render_failure_returns_fixed_plain_text_500 (console.rs:652-656) pins only status==500; the fixed body ('console rendering failed', console.rs:382) and content type (text/plain; charset=utf-8) are asserted nowhere. An Askama failure is not injectable at cucumber/browser layer; unit test is the only possible pin. Violates plan Task 3 and R6 (Card seq 45) + seq 67.

Plan Task 3 acceptance items HEAD and payload-absence have no test anywhere: no test or browser request uses Method::HEAD (UNSAFE_METHODS = POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH only); no assertion that a payload-less stage event's inspector renders no payload element (payload-absence assertions exist only on 404/500 error pages; browser inspector tests only visit entries with payloads). A violating implementation (405 on HEAD; null/envelope rendered for payload-less inspector) ships green under every gate.

payload.reason:
Adjudication of the code-execution review recorded at sequence 80. Both REFUTED verdicts were spot-validated by the orchestrator: CE-D dies on the recorded C13 adjudication at sequence 70 (the private StartupWire serialization path is operator-mandated; its equivalence is test-pinned), and CE-G dies on a fabricated citation (contract.md contains no schema-version clause; C14's multi-site condition is not met and the drift is instrumented by the cucumber oracle).

Ten findings stand. Severity adjudications: CE-B raised to major (a plan-mandated named test that cannot fail plus a fully unpinned accepted behavior is a definition-of-done defect, not a polish item); CE-I major as survived (the host-rejection-before-reads property has no instrument anywhere); the rest minor.

Disposition by theme: (1) Standards/conformance repairs - CE-A (derive the CLI port default from DEFAULT_PORT per the skeleton's own directive), CE-F (add the C12 reason comment the skeleton dictated), CE-H (delete the unused direct hyper dependency), CE-C (add Allow: GET, HEAD to the 405 guard - protocol MUST). (2) Complexity repairs - CE-E (one pool-level card-existence helper; the skeleton's 'each query text exists once' rationale was left unfulfilled for this probe). (3) Test-integrity repairs - the theme that dominates: CE-B (replace the tautology with a real pin of the no-second-success-line behavior), CE-I (make host_rejection_precedes_unreadable_storage actually make storage unreadable; fix the three named-case tests to assert their named behaviors), CE-J and CE-K (assert the full named behaviors, not just status/variant), CE-L (add the missing HEAD and payload-absence coverage the plan's acceptance list names).

Per the operator's recorded execution model, findings route to a fresh fix agent with the Card, the findings record at sequence 80, and the affected referents; the review orchestrator does not implement. After repair, the affected focused tests and gates rerun; repaired findings then receive refutation-grade re-verification before the all-green barrier is re-asserted.
